title: Port Scan / Network Reconnaissance Response Playbook

steps.action: Verify the source IP is external (not a known scanner / vulnerability management tool). Check the asset register.
If confirmed hostile, block the scanning IP at the perimeter firewall.
Identify which ports were probed — were any services exposed that should not be? Check firewall rule set.
Correlate the scan timestamp with subsequent connection attempts — did the scanner attempt exploitation after the scan?
Close unnecessary open ports. Ensure default-deny egress and ingress rules are in place.
Log the scanning IP and port list as IOCs. Update perimeter blocklist.
